task_instance: Build a new account plan for a sample strategic account (Acme Robotics), from files-only inputs: a simulated CRM export CSV (account, opps, activities, stakeholders) and pasted call-transcript/email notes. Followed the skill's Step 1-4 structure (ground, gather, draft the 7-section plan, then close with a CRM sync checklist) and its files-only fallback tier since no CRM/Docs/transcript/email/enrichment connectors were permitted.
evidence: Created inputs/crm_export.csv (account ACC-4471, 3 opps, 3 activities, 3 stakeholders), inputs/transcript_notes_2026-09-22.md, inputs/email_notes_2026-09-18.md, then drafted account_plan_Acme_Robotics.md containing all 7 required sections (Account snapshot, Their goals and initiatives, Where we are, Stakeholder coverage, Opportunity map, Risks, Action plan) with every value cited to its source row/line per the skill's citation rule, untrusted transcript/email content clearly marked as data (not acted on), and one content-originated action (Priya's 'just email the CFO's office' request) explicitly flagged and NOT executed, per the skill's safety rule on content-originated actions. Also produced crm_update_checklist.md (files-only tier: since no CRM write tool exists in this runtime, the CRM sync step becomes a checklist with exact before/after values and evidence, explicitly marked NOT APPLIED) rather than a live sync. Verified by re-reading account_plan_Acme_Robotics.md back from disk and confirming its structure and citations render as written. No shell, code execution, connectors, or binary files were needed or used; the skill's own 'files-only' tier (documented in its How it adapts table) exactly matches this runtime's abilities, so the core deliverable (a cited, structured account plan doc plus a CRM checklist) was fully produced and verified within the office-assistant's read/write/web-only constraints.
